HINTS:
WASD move · Shift sprint · Ctrl crouch · Q / E lean · Space jump and climb
T grab (wheel: nearer, farther · left button: throw) · F use and pick up · Tab inventory · 1–9 hotkeys · G drop from hand · X flashlight
F1–F4 style · F5 save · F9 load · F6 language · F10 data · F11 window · Esc mouse
MSG_BAD_SAVE: Save is damaged or from another version
INV_MASS: Weight: %.1f kg · felt: %.1f kg · comfortable up to %.0f kg
INV_HINTS: Left button: drag · R: rotate · Ctrl when grabbing: half a stack · double-click: open container · 1–9 over an item in vest or belt: hotkey · drop outside a window: to ground · Tab: close
INV_ERR_GONE: The item is no longer here
INV_ERR_SELF: A container cannot go inside itself
INV_ERR_NO_EXPAND: The container has no room to unfold
INV_ERR_NO_HOTKEY: Nothing is bound to this key
INV_ERR_NOT_QUICK: Hotkeys work for vest and belt
MSG_HAND_BUSY: Hand busy: put the item away (G or its key)
